presentation.label: MICROLOOPER
presentation.summary: Grab a tempo-synced piece of a track and loop it at any speed, forwards, backwards or as a pendulum, crossfaded in and out.
presentation.overview: Ghost Cut keeps the last 353 ms of its track in a ring. GRAB (a knob, a scene or the crossfader) freezes a piece of it, 1/64 to 1/4 of a note at the project's tempo, and loops it in place of the track; let go and the track fades back. RATE plays the loop from a quarter speed to almost four times, pitch and speed together like tape. CAPT chooses what GRAB takes: the last LEN (AUTO), the next LEN (MAN), or the ring as it was when you set OFF. DIR loops forwards, backwards or back and forth. A 256-sample crossfade hides the seam, and MIX blends the loop over the dry track.
highlights: GRAB with hysteresis: on at 96, off at 32, so a scene or the crossfader grabs once and lets go cleanly
LEN follows the tempo: 1/64 to 1/4 of a note, halved until it fits the 353 ms ring
RATE from 1/4 x to almost 4 x, pitch and speed together; FWD, REV and PEND
AUTO, MAN and OFF capture; the loop fades in and out over 256 samples
Exact dry passthrough whenever no loop plays
usage: On an audio track, hold FUNC and press FX2, turn LEVEL to GHOST CUT and press YES.
Play the track and turn GRAB past 96: the last 1/16 loops. Turn it under 32 to let go.
Turn RATE while it loops for tape-speed pitch, or set DIR on the SETUP page to REV or PEND.
For the crossfader: hold a scene key and turn GRAB to 127 to lock it in that scene, and leave the other scene's GRAB at 0. Sliding across grabs, sliding back lets go.

controls.name: LEN
controls.doc: Loop length at the next GRAB, in notes at the project's tempo: 1/64, 1/32, 3/64, 1/16, 3/32, 1/8, 3/16, 1/4. A length past the 353 ms ring is halved until it fits, so it stays in time.

controls.name: GRAB
controls.doc: 96 or more grabs a loop, 32 or less lets it go; between them nothing changes. Lock it per scene to grab with the crossfader.

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: The loop's speed and pitch together, drawn -64 to +63: 0 is the speed it was played at, -64 a quarter, +63 almost four times (an octave every 32 steps).

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: The loop over the dry track: 0 is the dry track exactly, 127 the loop alone.

controls.name: CAPT
controls.doc: What GRAB loops: AUTO the last LEN, MAN the next LEN (the track plays dry while it records), OFF the ring as it was when CAPT went OFF.

controls.name: DIR
controls.doc: FWD loops forwards, REV backwards, PEND forwards then backwards with no seam.

limitations: FX2 only: the ring needs an FX2 slot's buffer. On an FX1-sized slot it passes the track dry.
Mono loop: the ring records the track's mono sum, and the loop plays on both sides.
The longest loop is 353 ms; a longer LEN is halved until it fits.

The loop starts at GRAB and keeps its own length; it does not restart on the sequencer's steps, so it drifts by under a sample a repeat against the pattern. A GRAB locked on a trig starts it on that step.
RATE above 1 x has no anti-alias filter and reads with linear interpolation, so high content aliases when sped up.
Milestone A: PTCH, DRFT, ENG, GRN, MOTN and FDBK are not built yet.
Rendered in dsp_host only: not run on a unit or in the emulator.

steps: Select an audio track that plays something.
Hold FUNC and press FX2, turn LEVEL to GHOST CUT and press YES.
Press FX2 for the main page: LEN, GRAB, RATE and MIX. Press FX2 again for SETUP: CAPT and DIR.
